errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that 'Електрическа енергия' (Electrical energy) has the smallest share with 1.6%. According to the chart, 'Възобн. и биогорива' (Renewable and biofuels) has the smallest share with 1.2%.

errors.text_span: всички сектори са изобразени в равен размер на кръга
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims that all sectors are of equal size. In a pie chart, the size of each sector is proportional to its value. The sectors clearly have different sizes corresponding to their percentages (e.g., 69.8% is the largest, 1.2% is the smallest).
